title: Aphelion — a solar observatory
description: A contemplative Three.js solar-system toy with locally generated planetary textures, restrained orbital guides, eight planet dossiers, orbit/zoom controls, pause and simulation rate, reset, and an inspect view that follows the selected world. Responsive HTML controls, visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion support, and a readable WebGL fallback are included.

tests.name: Local Vite bundle, no writes
tests.outcome: Passed; exit code 0. Vite 7.3.6 transformed 7 modules and produced in-memory HTML, JavaScript, and CSS output. No build files written.

knownLimitations: No browser or WebGL rendering checks were performed: localhost browser access is unavailable under the generation brief.
Motion, orbital distances, and planet sizes are deliberately stylized; this is not an n-body or scientifically precise orbital simulation.
Planet textures and dossier previews are procedurally illustrated, not photographs.
